page.overview:
What is Sunflora?

Sunflora has been an apprentice at Wigglytuff's Guild for at least quite some time, apparently being already an apprentice a long time before the player and their partner, and calling the two "cute", implying she's also older than they are.

She is one of the most gifted apprentices at the Guild, as shown when she is chosen to apprehend Haunter, who was thought to be invincible.

She has a rocky relationship with Loudred, shown in both the main storyline and Today's "Oh My Gosh", the cause of which is never directly revealed, but her diary suggests this might be because Loudred got her knocked out of a dungeon once by storming of recklessly. This is shown in her often making rude remarks about Loudred. An example is when Loudred commented on what he would do if he lost his memory, during the strategy meeting at Foggy Forest, saying it wouldn't matter because he's forgetful anyway. Her diary entries about the events of the special episode, however, state she's warmed up to Loudred a little after this. She still makes the rude remarks to Loudred after this though.

In the Special Episode, Sunflora is assigned to capture an outlaw Haunter known as "Haunter the Invincible." She also has to deal with a fight she had with Loudred over his recklessness causing them to be knocked out while exploring a dungeon. Sunflora manages to defeat Haunter twice, but both times he gets back up as good as new after a blinding flash. After his second defeat, Haunter sics two Slugma he hired on Sunflora, but she is saved by Loudred. However, Sunflora becomes upset when Loudred claims he only came because Chatot made him and the two resume their fight. After Loudred leaves, Sunflora remembers him stating that the reason he was able to fend off the Slugma was because he just arrived and was at full strength and this gives he the answer behind Haunter's "invincibility." Sunflora chases Haunter to the bottom of Steam Cave where she reveals two more Haunter and explains that she figured out the three worked together to create an illusion of invincibility to discourage pursuers. The Haunter then reveal they led Sunflora to the bottom of Steam Cave because magma runs directly under it and it burns Sunflora. Suddenly, Loudred returns and the two defeat all three Haunter and arrest them. Afterward, Sunflora is rewarded with a Sun Scarf to help protect her from fire-types and she also learns Loudred wasn't sent by Chatot and decides to tell him something she was too stubborn to say before "thank you."
